title: Kundenspezifisches AI-Briefing
description: Briefing for the SAP account team about one end customer: Autonomous Enterprise Suite agents for Finance (5) and Supply Chain (8) with a consumption model per agent, the Business AI components BTP, Business Data Cloud and Joule Work, roadmap and the valid AI-credit contract type.
insights: Choose the customer at the top: Muster Industrie AG or Hanse Handelsgruppe AG. Contracts and AI-unit figures come from the Sub4Me sample data; the agents, their utilisation and the roadmap are made up.
Every agent has a status, a type, a utilisation and a consumption model: what is counted, AI units per event and events a month.

The AI-credit contract card shows the usual models (pay as you go, agreed consumption, fixed consumption, rollover, prepaid pool, top-up packs); a check marks the ones that are valid for the customer.
'Written briefing with Joule' asks the chat to turn the page into a one-page briefing.
prompt: Bundled example: Kundenspezifisches AI-Briefing (static, data embedded by npm run sync:customer-briefing).
